Mishneh Torah, Offerings for Those with:
Arvaa hen hannikrain mechussere kappara. hazzava. vehayyoledet. vehazzav. vehametzora. velamma nikrau mechussere kappara shekkol echad mehen af al pi shettahar mittumato vetaval veheeriv shimsho adayin hu chaser velo gamra tohorato kede leechol bekadashim ad sheyyavi karbano. vekodem sheyyavi kapparato asur hu leechol bekadashim kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin:
Ger shemmal vetaval vaadayin lo hevi karbano. af al pi shehu asur leechol bekadashim ad sheyyavi karbano eno mimmechussere kappara. shekkarbano ikkevo lihyot ger gamur velihyot kechol keshere yisrael umippene ze eno ochel bekadashim sheadayin lo naasa kichshere yisrael. vechevan sheyyavi karbano veyease yisrael kasher ochel bekadashim. hevi pereda achat beshacharit ochel bekadashim laerev veyavi pereda sheniyya. shekkarbano shel ger olat behema o shene bene yona o shete torim ushenehen ola. kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot:
Hazzav vehazzava karban kol achat mehen shete torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat. vehayyoledet karbanah keves ola uven yona o tor chattat. veim en yadah masseget mevia shete torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat. vehametzora karbano shelosha kevasim echad ola veechad asham. vechisba lechattat. veim en yado masseget mevi ken echad ola veechad chattat vecheves leasham:
Hazzav vehazzava vehametzora mevi kol echad mishshelashtan kapparato bayyom hashshemini letohorato shekkol echad mehen sofer shiva yeme tohora vetovel bayyom hashshevii umaariv shimsho umakriv karbenotav bayyom hashshemini:
Hayyoledet enah mevia karbanah beyom arbaim lezachar o beyom shemonim linkeva. ella maarevet shimshah umeviah karbanah lemachar shehu yom arbaim veechad lezachar veyom shemonim veechad linkeva vehu hayyom shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 12 6)</small> "uvimlot yeme tohorah leven o levat tavi" vegomer. veim hevia karbanah toch yeme melot lo yatzat afillu hevia al veladot harishonim betoch yeme melot shel valad ze lo yatzat. avru yamim ellu velo heviu kapparatan hare ellu makrivin kapparatan leachar zeman. vechol zeman shello hikrivu chattatam asurim leechol bekadashim. aval haola (vehaasham) enan meakkevin. kevar bearnu bemaase hakkarbanot shekkol mechuyyeve karban en makrivin al yadan ella middatan. chutz mimmechussere kappara sheen tzerichin daat bealim shehare adam mevi karban al banav uvenotav hakketannim im hayu mechussere kappara umaachilan bizvachim:
E zo hi zava. zo shezzav damah shelosha yamim ze achar ze belo et niddatah. vezo hi zava gedola shetztzericha sefirat shiva vechayyevet bekarban. uchevar bearnu beinyan hannidda ematay tihye haishsha zava bedamim shettire veematay lo tihye zava ella nidda o tehora umatay tihye sefek zava. kol makom sheamarnu shehi zava vesoferet shiva hare hi chayyevet lehavi karban vechattatah neechelet. vechol makom sheamarnu shehi sefek zava hare zo mevia karban veen chattata neechelet. shekkevar bearnu shechattat haof habbaa al hassafek tissaref. vesham bearnu ma teled haishsha o ma tappil vetihye temea leda uma teled o tappil velo tihye temea leda. vechol makom sheamarnu shehi temea leda hare zo mevia karban vechattatah neechelet. vechol makom sheamarnu sheenah temea leda hare zo petura min hakkarban:
Haishsha shello huchzeka ebbara vehippila velo yada ma hippila. im nefel shechayyevet alav karban o davar sheenah chayyevet alav karban. hare zo sefek yoledet umeviah karban veen chattata neechelet. vechen shete nashim shehippilu shene nefalim nefel echad rauy lehakeriv alav vehannefel haacher petura alav veen achat mehen makkeret niflah. kol achat mishshetehen mevia karban missafek veen chattat achat mishshetehen neechelet shechattat haof habbaa al hassafek nisrefet shemma enah chayyevet venimtzet chattat zo chullin shennishchatu baazara shehen asurin bahanaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot shechita:
Achat hayyoledet veachat hammappelet valad echad o veladot harebe hare zo mevia karban echad lechullan vehu shetteled kullan betoch yeme melot. aval im hippila achar yeme melot mevia af al hashsheni. ketzad. yalda nekeva kol nefalim shettappil miyyom halleda ad sof yom shemonim hare hen nechshavin im havvalad harishon ucheillu yalda teomim ze achar ze veenah mevia ella karban echad. hippila nefel beyom shemonim veechad umiyyom echad ushemonim vahala im hi reuya lekarban hare zo mevia alav bifne atzmo. yalda nekeva uleachar shishshim o shivim yom hippila nekeva sheniyya. kol nefel shettappil betoch shemonim shel nekeva zo hashsheniyya petura alav. vechen im hippila nekeva shelishit achar shishshim o shivim yom shel nekeva sheniyya. hare kol nefel shettappil betoch shemonim shel nekeva shelishit petura alav mippene shehu chashuv im hannefel hashshelishi vehannefel hashshelishi chashuv im hashsheni mippene shehu betoch yeme melot shello vehashsheni chashuv im harishona veenah mevia ella karban echad al hakkol:
Hayyoledet tumtum o anderoginus vehippila nefel achar arbaim miyyom ledato. hare zo mevia karban al nefel ze shemma zachar hu harishon vahare hippila achar melot. veen chattatah neechelet shemma nekeva hi harishona uvetoch melot hippila shehi petura mikkarban sheni:
Haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot o sefek chamesh zivot. mevia karban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova. hayu aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot vechamesh zavot vaddaot mevia karban echad veochelet bizvachim vehashshear aleha chova. vechen haddin bezav. hayu aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot vechamesh ledot safek o chamesh ledot vaddaot vechamesh zivot safek. mevia shene karbanot echad al havvadday veneechol ushear havvaddaot aleha chova veechad al hassafek veeno neechol veen hashshear aleha chova veochelet bizvachim:
Haishsha shennitgayyera veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyera yalda o mishshennitgayyera yalda. hare zo mevia karban missafek veen chattatah neechelet. kevar bearnu behilchot shegagot shekkol mechussere kappara missafek sheavar alehem [yom hakkippurim] chayyavin lehavi achar yom hakkippurim. shekkarban ze machshiran leechol bekadashim:
Haishsha sheyyesh aleha leda o ziva. mevia meot hakkinnim venotenet bashshofar veochelet bekadashim laerev chazaka sheen bet din shel kohanim omdin mishsham ad sheyyichlu kol hammaot shebbashshofar veyakrivu kenegdan kinnim. kemo shebbearnu bishkalim uvehilchot kele hammikdash vehaovdin bo:
Haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta yaviu hayyorshim olatah. af al pi shello hifrisha otah mechayyim kevar nishtaabbedu nechaseha lakkarban. vehashshibud din tora hu:

Hazav haamur battora hu shichvat zera habba mecholaye hachalalim shehi mitkabbetzet bahen. uchesheyyotze hazzov eno yotze bekoshi keshichvat zera veen bitziato taava velo hanaa ella nigrar veyotze kemo batzek shel seorim kehe keloven betza hammuzeret. aval shichvat zera levana keshura keloven betza sheenah muzeret:

Haroe reiyyot hazzov haggormot lo lihyot zav mechamat choli o ones vechayyotze bahen eno zav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 2)</small> "zav mibbesaro" mechamat besaro hu sheyyihye tame lo mechamat davar acher. mikkan amru beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav. bemaachol. uvemishte. bemassa. uvikfitza. becholi. uvemare. uvehirhur. ketzad. achal achila gassa o shata harebe. o sheachal o shata ochalin o mashkin hammeviin lide shichvat zera. o shennasa massoy kaved. o shekkafatz mimmakom lemakom uvichlal davar ze im hukka al gabbo. o shehaya chole. o sheraa ishsha vehitavva shechivatah. o shehirher beiske beila af al pi shello hirher bivilat ishsha shehu makkirah. im kadam echad mikkol ellu veraa reiyya shel zov tolin bo veeno metamme:

Haroe keri eno mittamme bezov meet leet sheriyya zo shel zov mechamat shichvat zera hi. vechen lemare ulehirhur tolin bahen meet leet. aval lemaachol ulemishte velikfitza ulemassa. tolin bahen kol zeman shemmitztaer:

Mi shemmal veachar kach raa zov ben akkum ben yisrael tolin bammila kol zeman shemmitztaer. akkum sheraa keri veachar kach nitgayyer metamme beziva miyyad veen tolin lo meet leet. katan en tolin lo lo bemare velo behirhur sheen lekatan mare vehirhur hammevi lide zov. lefichach bodkin oto bachamishsha derachim bilvad:

Ucheshem shettolin lekatan bechalyo kach tolin lo bocholi immo im haya yonek mimmenna o tzarich leimmo. bamme devarim amurim shebbodkin et hazzav bidrachim ellu biriyya sheniyya shel zov shebbah yease zav kemo sheyyitbaer. aval reiyya rishona afillu raa otah beones ureiyya sheniyya mechamat besaro hare ze tame tumat zivut. veaf al pi chen bodkin oto barishona kede limnot bah shalosh reiyyot lechayyevo karban. reiyya shelishit en bodkin oto bah ella afillu raa otah mechamat ones hoil venizkak letuma shehare reiyyot shennaasa bahen zav mechamat besaro haya lefichach yitchayyev bekarban:

Haroe reiyya achat shel zov hare hu kevaal keri. raa shetayim hare ze zov vetzarich sefirat shiva uviat mayim chayyim veeno chayyav bekarban. raa shalosh reiyyot hare ze zav gamur vechayyav bekarban. veen ben zav sheraa shete reiyyot leroe shalosh ella karban bilvad. udevarim ellu kullan divre kabbala mippi moshe rabbenu missinay:

Echad haroe shete reiyyot o shalosh beshaa achat zo achar zo o sheraa reiyya bechol yom ze achar ze hare ze zav. lefi shettala hakkatuv et hazzava beyamim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 25)</small> "ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim" vehazzav lo tala oto beyamim:

Veim hifsik hazzav ben reiyya liriyya yom gamur enan mitztarfot. ketzad. raa reiyya beshabbat ureiyya sheniyya besheni beshabbat enan mitztarfot veeno zav. vechen im raa reiyya sheniyya beechad beshabbat veraa reiyya shelishit bishlishi beshabbat eno chayyav bekarban sheen zo mitztarefet lishtayim shehare hifsik benehen yom echad. aval im raa achat hayyom veachat ballayla shelleacharav hare ellu mitztarfot. veen tzarich lomar sheim raa achat ballayla usheniyya bayyom shehen mitztarfot. vechen im raa shalosh reiyyot bishlosha lelot ze achar ze hare ellu mitztarfot:
Reiyyat hazzav en lah shiur ella haroe kol shehu tame shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 3)</small> "hechtim besaro" kol shehu. nikkar bivsaro metamme:

Haya hazzov nigrar veyotze velo pasak. im yesh mittechillat hariyya ad sofah kede tevila vesippug o yeter hare zo nechshevet kishte reiyyot hoil vehi arukka kishtayim. veim lo hayta arukka kashshiur hazze afillu pasak hazzov bentayim hare zo reiyya achat. vechen im hayta reiyya achat arukka keshalosh reiyyot shennimtza mittechillatah vead sofah kishte tevilot ushene sippugin hare zo nechshevet keshalosh reiyyot veyavi karban:

Raa reiyya achat bayyom vehifsik kede tevila vesippug veachar kach raa shetayim o achat arukka kishtayim o sheraa shetayim o achat merubba kishtayim vehifsik kede tevila vesippug veachar kach raa reiyya achat hare ze zav gamur:

Raa reiyya achat mikketzatah besof hayyom umiktzatah bitchillat hallayla af al pi sheenah arukka kishtayim hare ellu shete reiyyot shehayyamim mechallekin hariyya. lefichach haroe reiyya achat ben hashshemashot shehu safek min hayyom umin hallayla hare ze safek letuma:
Raa reiyya achat bayyom veachat ben hashshemashot hare ze vadday letuma vesafek lekarban umevi karban veeno neechol:

[Raa] reiyya achat ben hashshemashot [shel shabbat] ureiyya sheniyya ben hashshemashot shel motzae shabbat hare ze safek letuma vesafek lekarban. safek letuma shemma reiyya rishona hayta beerev shabbat usheniyya bemotzae shabbat vahare hifsik shabbat benehen veen kan zivut kelal. vahare hu safek lekarban shemma achat mehen hayta mikketzatah bayyom umiktzatah ballayla shehi chashuva kishtayim vahare raa shalosh reiyyot shehu chayyav bekarban. ulefichach mevi karban veeno neechol:

Kol hayyamim shehazzav roe bahen zivot hare hu tame. uchesheyyifsok hazzivot mone shiva yamim nekiyyim kezava vetovel bashshevii umaariv shimsho uvashshemini mevi karbano im haya baal shalosh reiyyot. veim raa reiyya shel zov afillu besof yom shevii achar shettaval satar hakkol umatchil limnot shiva yamim nekiyyim meachar yom reiyya haacharona:
Zav sheraa keri beechad mishshivat yeme hassefira eno soter ella yomo bilvad umashlim shiva yamim umevi karbano. ketzad. raa keri bayyom hachamishi sofer acharav shelosha yamim vetovel bashshelishi umevi karbano barvii:
Zav shebbadak beyom rishon mime hassefira umatza tahor velo badak kol shiva uvayyom hashshevii badak umatza tahor hare ze bechezkat tohora. afillu badak beyom hattuma atzmah umatza tahor ufasak hazzov velo badak lemachar bitchillat yeme hassefira uvadak bashshevii o bashshemini umatza tahor alu lo yeme hassefira vahare ze bechezkat tohora:
Kol reiyya shehi soteret enah mevia lide karban. ketzad. raa shete reiyyot vehifsik yom o yomayim vahare hu mone shiva yamim nekiyyim uvetoch hashshiva raa reiyya shel zov enah mitztarefet lishtayim ella soteret umatchil limnot kemo shebbearnu. afillu raa betoch yeme hassefira shalosh reiyyot zo achar zo. afillu raa otam beyom echad. afillu raa shalosh reiyyot besof yom shevii shel shiva yamim nekiyyim. eno mevi karban sheriyyot ellu listira hen. raa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini mevi karban sheen reiyyot ellu sotrin. bamme devarim amurim bezav baal shete reiyyot. aval bezav baal shalosh reiyyot belel shemini shelleachar shivat yamim nekiyyim eno mevi karban sheni al shalosh reiyyot ellu ella karban echad al hashshalosh harishonot. sheaf al pi sheen shalosh acharonot sotrot hare lo yatza lizman sherauy lekarban vehallayla mechussar zeman hu lakkol. chutz miyyoledet shehippila belel shemonim veechad shehi mevia karban sheni kemo shebbearnu. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala:
Raa reiyya achat belel shemini ushete reiyyot beyom shemini hare ellu mitztarfin umevi karban sheni al zivot haacharonot. shehare reiyya rishona shel kol zav keshichvat zera hi chashuva veim raa achareha shetayim mitztarefet immahem lekarban. aval im raa shetayim belel shemini veachat beyom shemini en mitztarefet veeno mevi karban al hazziva zo haacharona:
Hakkol mittammein beziva afillu katan ben yomo vehaggerim vehaavadim vecheresh veshote. veyerae li shemmeviin alehen kappara kede lehaachilan bekadashim vechattatan neechelet shehare hen kekatan sheeno ben daat. useris adam useris chamma mittammein beziva kechol haanashim:
Hattumtum vehaanderoginus notnin alehen chumre haish vechumre haishsha. mittammein bedam kenashim uveloven kaanashim vetumatan besafek. lefichach im haya echad mehen baal shalosh reiyyot o zava sheraata dam shelosha yamim ze achar ze meviin karban veeno neechol. haya mone shiva yamim nekiyyim leloven veraa odem o leodem veraa loven hare ze eno soter:

Kesheyyitrappe hatztzarua mitztzarato achar shemmetaharin oto beetz erez veezov usheni tolaat ushete tzipporim umegallechin et kol besaro umatbilin oto achar kol zot yikkanes lirushalayim umone shivat yamim uvayyom hashshevii megalleach tiglachto sheniyya kattiglachat harishona vetovel vahare hu tevul yom umaariv shimsho ulemachar bashshemini tovel paam sheniyya veachar kach makrivin karbenotav. umippene ma tovel bashshemini achar shettovel meemesh. mippene shehaya ragil betuma bime chilluto veeno nizhar mishshum tuma veshemma nitma achar shettaval. lefichach tovel bashshemini beezrat hannashim belishkat hametzoraim sheshsham af al pi shello hissiach dato:
Nitacher velo gilleach bashshevii vegilleach bashshemini o achar kamma yamim bayyom sheyyegalleach yitbol veyaariv shimsho ulemachar yavi karbenotav achar sheyyitbol paam sheniyya kemo shebbearnu. ketzad osin lo. hametzora omed chutz leezrat yisrael keneged petach mizrachit beaskuppat shaar nikanor ufanav lemaarav vesham omdim kol mechussere kappara beet shemmetaharin otan vesham mashkin et hassotot. vehakkohen lokeach asham shel metzora keshehu chay umenifo im log hashshemen bammizrach kederech kol hattenufot. veim henif ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo yatza. veachar kach mevi et haasham shel metzora ad happetach umachnis shete yadav laazara vesomech alav veshochatin oto miyyad. umekabbelin shene kohanim et damo. echad mekabbel bichli vezorko al gabbe hammizbeach veechad beyado hayemanit umeare leyado hassemalit umazze beetzbao hayemanit. veim shinna vekibbel bismol techilla pasal. hakkohen shekkibbel miktzat haddam bichli molicho vezorko al hammizbeach techilla. veachar kach yavo hakkohen shekkibbel haddam bechappo etzel hametzora. hakkohen mibbifnim vehametzora mibbachutz. umachnis hametzora rosho venoten hakkohen min haddam shebbechappo al tenuch azno hayemanit. veachar kach yachnis yado hayemanit veyitten al bohen yado veachar kach yachnis raglo hayemanit veyitten al bohen raglo veim natan al hassemol lo yatza. veachar kach yakriv chattato veolato. veachar sheyyitten haddam al habbehonot notel hakkohen millog hashshemen veyotzek letoch chappo shel chavero hassemalit veim yatzak letoch kaf atzmo yatza. vetovel etzbao hayemanit bashshemen shebbechappo umazze sheva peamim keneged bet kodesh hakodashim al kol hazaya tevilat etzba beshemen. veim hizza velo kivven keneged bet kodesh hakodashim kesherot. veachar kach yavo etzel hametzora veyitten min hashshemen al mekom dam haasham bitnuch ozen uvohen yado uvohen raglo. vehannotar min hashshemen shebbechappo yittenennu al rosh hammittaher veim lo natan lo kipper. ushear hallog mitchallek lakkohanim:
Sheyare hallog eno neechol ella baazara lezichre kehunna kishar kadshe kadashim shehare hukkash leasham. veasur leechol millog hashshemen ad sheyyitten mimmennu mattan sheva umattan behonot veim achal loke keochel kadashim kodem zerika:

E zehu tenuch ozen ze gader haemtzai. natan al tzidde habbehonot kasher. natan al tzidde tziddehen pasul. ben shennatan hashshemen al dam haasham atzmo milmala ben shennatan betzad haddam afillu nitkanneach haddam kodem sheyyitten hashshemen al behonot yatza shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 28)</small> "al mekom dam haasham". en lo bohen yad yemanit o bohen regel yemanit o sheen lo ozen yemanit en lo tohora olamit:
Asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo o shello natan middamo al gabbe behonot hare ze ole lammizbeach vetaun nesachim keniske asham metzora vetzarich hametzora asham acher lehacheshiro:
Hikdim chattato laashamo lo yihye acher memares bedamah ella teebbar tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa:
Yesh leadam lehavi ashamo hayyom velogo achar asara yamim. veim ratza leshannot hallog laasham metzora acher meshanne af al pi shekkadash bichli. chasar hallog ad shello yatzak yemalleennu. chasar meachar sheyyatzak yavi acher battechilla:
Yatzak min hashshemen lechappo vehitchil lehazzot venishpach hallog im ad shello gamar mattan sheva nishpach hallog yavi acher veyatchil bemattan sheva. gamar mattan sheva venishpach hallog yavi acher veyatchil lechattechilla babbehonot. hitchil babbehonot venishpach hallog kodem sheyyigmor yavi acher veyatchil lechattechilla babbehonot. gamar habbehonot veachar kach nishpach hallog kodem sheyyitten shear hashshemen shebbechappo al rosh hammittaher eno tzarich lehavi log acher shemmattenat harosh enah meakkevet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 18)</small> "vehannotar bashshemen" <small>(Vayikra 14 17)</small> "umiyyeter hashshemen":
Hikdim mattan shemen lemattan dam yemalle hallog shemen veyachzor veyitten hashshemen achar haddam. hikdim mattan shemen al habbehonot lemattan sheva yemalle hallog veyachzor veyitten al habbehonot achar mattan sheva shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 2)</small> "zot tihye torat hametzora" shettihye kol torato al hasseder:
Natan sheva hammattanot shello lishman lo hurtza vehuchshar hametzora:
Metzora shennitnaggea achar shehevi ashamo tzarich karban acher letzaraat sheniyya. vechen im hevi ashamo venitnaggea tzarich karban al kol achat veachat. aval im nitnaggea venirpa vehevi tzipporav vechazar venitnaggea venitrappe vehevi tzipporav karban echad lechullan:
Metzora shehevi karban ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni kodem sheyyakriv karbenotav hakkol holech achar haasham. im haya bishat shechitat haasham ashir yeshallem karban ashir veim haya ani yeshallem karban ani:
Shene metzoraim shennitarvu karbenotehen venizrak dam achat mishshete hachattaot shellahen veachar kach met echad min hametzoraim ketzad ose ze hametzora hachay. lehavi chattat behema eno yachol shemma zo shennizrak damah chattato hi veen meviin chattat behema al hassafek. ulehavi chattat haof eno yachol sheashir shehevi karban ani lo yatza. vechetzad yaase. yichtov kol nechasav leacher venimtza ani veyavi chattat haof missafek velo teachel kemo shebbearnu venimtza ochel bekadashim:
Ashir sheamar karbano shel metzora ze alav vehametzora haya ani hare ze mevi al yado karbenot ashir shehare yad hannoder masseget. veani sheamar karbano shel metzora ze alay vehaya hametzora ashir hare ze mevi al yado karbenot ashir shehare ze hannoder chayyav bekarbenot ashir:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 1: Kol hammemir loke al kol behema uvehema sheyyamir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto" veaf al pi shello asa maase. mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol mitzvat lo taase sheen bah maase en lokin aleha chutz minnishba umemir umekallel et chavero beshem. shelosha lavin ellu i efshar sheyyihye bahen maase kelal velokin alehen. velamma lokin al hattemura vahare lav shebbah nittak laase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "veim hamer yemirennu vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh". mippene sheyyesh bah ase ushene lavin. veod sheen lav shebbah shave laase. shehatztzibbur vehashshuttafin en osin temura im hemiru af al pi shehen muzharin shello yamiru. nimtzeta omer shehayyachid shehemir hare hattemura kodesh. vaafillu hemir beshabbat loke arbaim. veechad min hashshuttafin shehemir. o mi shehemir bekarban mikkarbenot hatztzibbur. hoil veyesh lo bahen shuttafut hare ze loke veen hattemura kodesh:

Echad hammemir bezadon o shehemir bishgaga hare ze ose temura veloke. ketzad. hammitkavvin lomar hare zo temurat ola sheyyesh li veamar hare zo temurat shelamim sheyyesh li. hare zo temura veloke. aval im dimma shemmuttar lehamir vehemir o sheamar ekkanes levayit ze veamir middati venichnas veshachach vehemir shello middato hare zo temura veeno loke aleha:

En adam memir behemto bekarban sheeno shello. veim amar baal hakkarban kol harotze lehamir bivhemti yavo veyamir hare ze memir bah. hemir karbano bivhema sheenah shello enah temura sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello:

Hammitkapper hu sheose temura aval lo hammakdish. ketzad. hikdish behema sheyyitkapper bah chavero kegon shehikdish karbenot nazir sheyyitkapper bahem peloni hannazir. oto hannazir hu sheose bahen temura aval lo ze shehikdish lefi sheenan shello:
Hayyoresh memir. hinniach behema lishne banav umet hare zo kereva veen memirin bah shehare hem bah shuttafin vehashshuttafin en osin temura kemo shebbearnu:
En kadshe nachrim osin temura min hattora aval middivre sofrim shehannachri shehemir hare zo temura. hikdish hannachri behema sheyyitkapper bah yisrael vehemir bah hannachri hare zo sefek temura:
Echad anashim veechad nashim im hemiru osin temura:
Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim shehemir. af al pi sheeno loke yesh bo safek im ose temura o eno ose temura:

En hakkohanim memirin bechattat uveasham sheaf al pi shehem shellahem enan zochin bahen mechayyim sheen lahem babbasar ad sheyyizzarek haddam. veen hakkohanim memirin bivchor sheaf al pi shehu zoche bo mechayyim eno zoche bo mittechilla shehare techillato bevet yisrael hu. aval habbealim shehemiru bivchor kol zeman shehu bevetam osim temura. vechen kohen shehemir bivchor shennolad lo lo bivchor shellakach miyyisrael hare zo temura:
Elo shel kohen gadol ose temura aval paro eno ose temura af al pi shehu mishshello hoil veechav hakkohanim mitkapperin bo hare hem bo keshuttafin:
Haofot vehammenachot enan osin temura shello neemar ella <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "behema":

Karbenot bedek habbayit enan osin temura shenneemar bemaaser <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu" vahalo hammaaser bichlal kol hakkadashim haya velamma yatza lelammed al hakkelal ma maaser karban yachid yatzu karbenot tzibbur vechen hashshuttafin ma maaser karban mizbeach yatzu kadshe bedek habbayit ma maasar behema hukkash lemaasar dagan sheen chayyavin bo ella yisrael velo nachrim yatzu karbenot nachrim sheen osin temura kemo shebbearnu:

Hammakdish baalat mum kavua enah osa temura mippene shello nitkaddesh gufah kiddush gamur veenah ella kedushshat damim. aval hammakdish baalat mum over o shehikdish temima veachar kach nolad lah mum kavua hare zo osa temura:

Echad hammemir tamim bevaal mum o baal mum betamim o shehemir bakar betzon o tzon bevakar. o kevasim beizzim o izzim bichvasim o nekevot bizcharim o zecharim binkevot. o shehemir echad bemea o mea beechad ben bevat achat ben bazo achar zo. hare zo temura veloke keminyan habbehemot shehemir:

En hattemura osa temura velo velad behemot hahekdesh ose temura shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "vehaya hu utemurato" hu velo velado utemurato velo temurat temurato. aval hammemir bivhema vechazar vehemir bah vechazar vehemir afillu elef kullan temura veloke al kol echad veechad kemo shebbearnu:

En memirin evarim o ubbarim bishlemim velo shelemim bahen. ketzad. haomer raglah shel behema zo o yadah tachat ola zo o sheamar ubbar behema zo tachat ola zo enah temura. vechen haomer behema zo tachat yadah o raglah shel ola zo o sheamar behema zo tachat ubbarah shel chattat zo enah temura:

Hammemir bechilayim o bitrefa veyotze dofen o betumtum veanderoginus en hakkedushsha chala alehen vahare ze kemi shehemir begamal o bachamor lefi sheen beminan karban ulefichach eno loke. ma ben ellu levaal mum. baal mum yesh beminan karban. ellu en beminam karban:
Harovea vehannirba hare hem kevaal mum veosin temura. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:
Behema shechetzyah kodesh vechetzyah chol lo osa temura velo naaset temura:
Kol hachattaot sheddinan sheyyamutu enan osin temura vechol chattat sheddinah shettire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher osa temura:

Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o leolato o laashamo osa temura af al pi sheenan reuyin likkarev hoil veyardu likdushshat damim vahare hem temimim yardu likdushshat hagguf. aval hammafrish sair lechattato venasi shehifrish seira lechattato vechohen gadol shehifrish para lechattato. enan osin temura shekkol hameshanne bechattaot lo nitkaddesha kelal vaafillu kedushshat damim kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 2:
Hatemura hu sheyyomar baal hakkarban al behemat chullin sheyyesh lo hare zo tachat zo. o hare zo chalifat zo. veen tzarich lomar im amar hare zo tachat chattat zo o tachat ola zo shehi temura. vechen im amar hare zo tachat chattat sheyyesh li betoch habbayit o tachat ola sheyyesh li bemakom peloni hare zo temura vehu sheyyesh lo. aval im amar al behemat chullin hare zo tachat ola o hare zo tachat chattat lo amar kelum. vechen im amar hare zo mechullelet al zo enah temura:
Hayu lefanav shete behemot achat chullin veachat hekdesh shennafal bah mum. hinniach yado al behemat chullin veamar hare zo tachat zo hare zo temura veloke. hinniach yado al behemat hekdesh veamar hare zo tachat zo hare ze chillelah al behemat hachullin veen zo temura ella kefode baalat mum bezo habbehema:
Hayu lefanav shalosh behemot kadshe mizbeach veachat mehen baalat mum shehare hi omedet lefidyon veshalosh behemot temimot chullin veamar hare ellu tachat ellu. hare shetayim min hachullin tachat shetayim hattemimot temuratan temura veloke alehem shetayim. vehabbehema hashshelishit hi tachat baalat mum shennitchallela aleha ulechallelah nitkavven velo lehamir bah. shekkevan sheyyesh lefanav derech issur vehi hattemura vederech hetter vehu hachillul chazaka hi sheen adam manniach hahetter veose haissur ulefichach eno loke shalosh malkiyyot. vechen im amar eser behemot ellu tachat eser behemot ellu veachat mehen baalat mum eno loke ella tesha malkiyyot shehabbehema haasirit lechallelah nitkavven velo lehamir bah. sheaf al pi shehuchzak ze bemalkiyyot harebe hoil veyesh sham derech hetter eno manniach devar hahetter veose haissur. shete behemot shel hekdesh veachat mehen baalat mum ushete behemot shel chullin veachat mehen baalat mum veamar hare ellu tachat ellu hare hattemima temurat hattemima veloke achat uvaalat hammum mechullelet al baalat hammum sheeno meniach hahetter veose haissur:
Haomer hare zo temurat ola ushelamim devarav kayyamim vetimmacher veyavi bachatzi dameha temurat ola uvachatzi dameha temurat shelamim. amar hare zo temurat ola utemurat shelamim im nitkavven lechach mittechilla devarav kayyamim veim lo nitkavven battechilla ella litmurat ola vechazar veamar temurat shelamim af al pi shechazar betoch kede dibbur en tofsin ella lashon rishon vahare hi temurat ola bilvad:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 3:
Ketzad din hattemurot likkarev. temurat haola tikkarev ola veim hayta temuratah nekeva o baalat mum tire hannekeva ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha ola. temurat hachattat tamut kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin. temurat haasham tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava. temurat hashshelamim kishlamim lechol davar teuna semicha unesachim utenufat chaze veshok. temurat hattoda ketoda ella sheenah teuna lechem kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin. temurat happesach im hemir bah kodem chatzot yom arbaa asar en temurato kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyavi bedameha shelamim veim hemir bah achar chatzot hare hattemura atzmah tikkarev shelamim. temurat habbechor vehammaaser enam kerevin leolam shenneemar bivchor <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "laAdonai hu". mippi hashshemua lamdu hu karev veen temurato kereva. vedin hammaaser bivchor temuratan tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veteachel: 
Temurat habbechor lakkohanim utemurat hammaaser labbealim. ucheshem sheen podin bechor umaaser shennafal bahen mum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach kach en podim temuratan:
Behema shehikdishah chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim temuratah kamoha. vechen kol behemat hekdesh sheenah kereva mippene techillat hekdeshah hare temuratah kamoha. amar chatzi behema zo temura vechetzyah ola hare zo tikkarev ola. chetzyah ola vechetzyah maaser tikkarev ola. chetzyah temura vechetzyah maaser hare zo safek veenah kereva:
Hammakdish baalat mum over veen tzarich lomar temima veachar kach nolad bah mum kavua venifdet vehemir bah achar shennifdet. hare zo temura veenah kereva veenah nifdet ella mannichah ad shettamut. enah kereva mippene shebbaa mikkoach kedushsha dechuya veenah nifdet sheen bechoach kedushshatah litposho pidyonah:
Kol hattemurot shehayu baale mumin kevuin mittechillatan hare ellu yippadu veenan yotzin lechullin lechol davar kede sheyyihyu muttarin begizza vaavoda achar pidyonan. shehakkedushsha chala battemura al baalat mum kavua shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "o ra betov" vera haamur kan hu baal mum vechayyotze bo sheeno rauy lekarban veaf al pi chen katuv bo <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> "yihye kodesh":
Ola shennitarva bizvachim vehemir beachat min hattaarovot hare ze mevi behema acheret veomer im temurat ola hi zo hare behema zo shelamim veim temurat shelamim hi zo hare behema zo ola. venimtza habbehema shehevi im hattemura keola ushelamim shennitarvu ze baze. chazar vehemir beachat mishshetehen veen yadua bee zo mehen hemir. mevi zevach acher mittoch beto. veomer al hattemura hashsheniyya. im temurat temura hi zo hare zo shehevi chullin. veim temurat ola o shelamim hi hare ze shehevi ola o shelamim. vahare ze shehevi im hattemura hashsheniyya kezevach utemura shennitarvu ze baze. uchevar bearnu din hattaarovot behilchot pesule hammukdashin:
Shelamim shennitarvu bivchor o bemaaser vehemir beechad mehen hare ze lo yikrav ella yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippade veyeachel kivchor o kemaaser kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 4: Ketzad din valdot hakkadashim. velad shelamim uvelad temurat shelamim hare ellu kishlamim vehen atzman kishlamim lechol davar. vechen velad hattoda uvelad temuratah hare ellu yikkarvu ketoda ella sheenan teunin lechem sheen meviin lechem ella im hattoda atzmah. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 12)</small> "al zevach hattoda" alav velo al veladah velo al temuratah kemo shebbearnu. bamme devarim amurim bavveladot atzman aval valde veladot enan kerevin. shemmittoch maasav nikkar shehu mashhe otan legaddel mehen adarim adarim ulefichach konsin oto velo yakrivem:
Velad hachattat yamut veen tzarich lomar velad temuratah:
Hashshochet et hachattat umatza bah ben arbaa chay hare zo neechelet kivsar hachattat. shevvalde hakkadashim bime imman hem kedoshim:

Velad temurat haasham uvelad veladah ad sof haolam yiru ad sheyyippol bahem mum veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava. veim yalda zachar achar shehikriv ashamo havvalad atzmo yikkarev ola. hifrish nekeva laashamo veyalda tire hi uvenah ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyimmachru veyavi bidme shenehem ashamo. veim kevar hikriv ashamo yippelu demehen lindava:

Velad temurat haola uvelad veladah ad sof haolam hare ellu keola vehen atzman yikkarvu ola. hifrish nekeva leolato veyalda af al pi sheyyalda zachar yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyavi bedamav ola. kevar bearnu bemaase hakkarbanot shekkol makom sheanu omrin yippelu lindava hu sheyyitten hammaot bashshofarot shehayu bammikdash shebbearnu bishkalim kamma hem. uvet din makrivin beotan hammaot olot nedava veniskehem mishshel tzibbur veenan teunot semicha. aval makom shenneemar hu atzmo yikrav ola o yavi bedamav ola. hare zo teuna semicha unesacheha mishshello:

Velad hammaaser. [uvelad] temurat hammaaser. velad temurat habbechor uvalde valdotehen ad sof haolam. hare ellu lo yikkarvu ella yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyeachlu kivchor uchemaaser shennafal bahen mum. valdot temurat habbechor lechohen. valdot maaser utemurato livalav:

Velad temurat happesach kitmurat happesach. im hayta immo kereva shelamim veladah yikkarev shelamim veim haya dinah shettimmacher veyavi bedameha shelamim af veladah nimkar veyavi bedamav shelamim. hifrish nekeva lefischo veyalda. o shehifrishah meubberet. hi uveladah yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidmehen pesach. veim nishara nekeva zo ad achar happesach o sheyyalda achar happesach. tire hi uveladah ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidmehen shelamim:
Valdot hakkadashim sheyyatzu derech dofen. o sheyyaldu tumtum veanderoginus vechilayim uterefa. hare ellu yippadu veyavi bidmehen karban harauy lehavi bidme valad shel zo:
Velad baalat mum hare hu kivlad hattemima lechol davar veyikkarev karauy lo:
Kadashim shehippilu nefel o shilya yikkavru vahare hem asurim bahanaa:

Hameshanne et hakkadashim mikkedushsha likdushsha over belo taase shenneemar bivchor <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "lo yakdish ish oto" shello yaasennu ola o shelamim. vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim sheen meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha echad kadshe mizbeach veechad kadshe bedek habbayit. ketzad. im hikdish levedek hahechol lo yeshanne levedek hammizbeach. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veen lokin al lav ze:

Ketzad maarimin al habbechor lehakedisho lammizbeach hekdesh acher. makdisho babbeten kodem sheyyivvaled shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "asher yevukkar laAdonai" <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "lo yakdish ish oto". mishsheyyevukkar i atta makdisho aval atta makdisho babbeten. lefichach yesh lo lomar ma shebbemeeha shel mavkeret zo im hu zachar hare zo ola. aval eno yachol lomar zivche shelamim sheeno yachol lehafekia oto mikkedushshato kede lehanot bo. veim amar im yetziat rov rosho yihye ola hare ze bechor veeno ola:

Veen maarimin al behemat hekdesh lehakedish ubbarah kedushsha acheret ella hare hu kikdushshat immo. shevvaldot hakkadashim mimmee immam hem kedoshim kemo shebbearnu. vahare kol ubbar mehen kikdushshat immo veeno yachol leshannoto babbeten kederech sheasa bivchor shehabbechor bitziato hu shemmitkaddesh. af al pi shekkol chukke hattora gezerot hem kemo shebbearnu besof meila. rauy lehitbonen bahen vechol ma sheatta yachol litten lo taam ten lo taam. hare amru chachamim harishonim shehammelech shelomo hevin rov hatteamim shel kol chukke hattora. yerae li shezze sheamar hakkatuv <small>(Vayikra 27 10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh". kainyan sheamar <small>(Vayikra 27 15)</small> "veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit kesef erkecha alav". yarda tora lesof machashevet haadam uketzat yitzro hara. shetteva shel adam note leharebot kinyano velachus al mamono veaf al pi shennadar vehikdish efshar shechazar bo venicham veyifde befachot mishshavyo amra tora im pada leatzmo yosif chomesh. vechen im hikdish behema kedushshat hagguf shemma yachzor bo vechevan sheeno yachol lifdotah yachlifenna bifchuta mimmenna. veim titten lo reshut lehachelif hara beyafe yachlif hayyafe bera veyomar tov hu. lefichach satam hakkatuv befanav shello yachlif. ukenaso im hechlif veamar vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh. vechol ellu haddevarim kede lachof et yitzro uletakken deotav. verov dine hattora enan ella etzot merachok miggedol haetza letakken haddeot uleyashsher kol hammaasim. vechen hu omer <small>(Mishlei 22 20)</small> "halo chatavti lecha shalishim bemoetzot vadaat". lehodiacha kosht imre emet lehashiv amarim emet lesholchecha:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by a Corpse 1:
Hammet metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel tumat shiva. vetumat magga veohel meforashin battora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 11)</small> "hannogea bemet lechol nefesh adam vetame shivat yamim". veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 14)</small> "kol habba el haohel vechol asher baohel yitma shivat yamim": 
Tumat massa mippi hashshemua. vekal vachomer haddevarim im nevela shehi tumat erev veenah metammea beohel metammea bemassa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 28)</small> "vehannsho et nivlatam" hammet lo kol shekken. uma nevela shemmaggaah tumat erev massaah tumat erev af hammet shemmaggao tumat shiva massao tumat shiva. en tumat massa bemet middivre sofrim ella din tora. veyerae li sheshshatak mimmenna hakkatuv kederech sheshshatak meissur habbat lefi sheasar beferush afillu bat habbat. veshatak meissur achilat basar bechalav lefi sheasar beferush afillu bishshulo. kach shatak mittumat massa bemet lefi shettimme beferush afillu tumat oholo kol shekken massao: 
Tumat magga haamura bechol makom ben bemet ben bishar hametammeim hu shennaga haadam bivsaro battuma atzmah. ben beyado ben beraglo ben bishar besaro vaafillu bilshono hare ze nitma. vechen nire li sheim naga betzipparnav o beshinnav nitma kevan shehem mechubbarim lagguf hare hem keguf. aval im tachav adam tuma bechush vehichnisah letoch gerono shel adam tahor velo naga bilshono. o shehichnisah letoch mei shel ishsha millematta velo naga bivsarah. lo nitma habbolea mishshum magga ze shehare lo naga bivsaro. shennegiat penim enah negia: 
Kerum sheal hammakka hare hu keor habbasar leinyan magga tumot. ucheshut sheal hakkatan enah keor habbasar. ketzad. mi shennaga tuma bikrum makkato nitma keillu naga beoro. naga besear haddak sheal besar hakkatan lo nitma. vechen adam tame shehayta bo makka venaga hattahor bikrum makkat hattame nitma. im haya katan tame venaga hattahor bakkeshut shello lo nitma ben betumat met ben bishar tumot. vechen lichluche tzoa o tit vechayyotze bahem middevarim sheen chotztzin al hagguf vechen gilde tzoa min haddevarim shechotztzin al hagguf enam keor habbasar lo letamme velo lehittamme: 
Keshem sheadam mittamme bingiato betuma kach hakkelim mittammeim bingiat hattuma bahen. chutz mikkeli cheres sheeno mittamme ella meaviro kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot kelim. [vezehu kelal gadol battuma. kol hametamme adam bemagga metamme kelim. vechol sheeno metamme adam bemagga eno metamme kelim. veen adam vechelim mekabbelin tuma ella meav hattuma]: 
Tumat massa haamura bechol makom ben bemet ben bishar kol hametammeim bemassa. hu sheyyissa haadam hattuma af al pi shello naga bah. afillu haya beno levenah even hoil venasa nitma. veechad hannose al rosho o al yado o al shear gufo. veechad hannose hu beatzmo o shennesaah acher vehinnichah lemala mizze hoil venisset alav mikkol makom nitma vaafillu hayta hattuma teluya bechut o bisaro vetala hachut beyado vehigbiah hattuma kol shehu hare ze nose venitma: 
Mesit bichlal nose hu. vechol davar shemmetamme bemassa metamme behesset. ketzad. kora shehi munnachat al hakkotel veal tziddah met o nevela vechayyotze bahen. uva hattahor liktze hakkora hashsheni vehenido. kevan shehenid et hattuma shebbakkatze hashsheni tame mishshum nose. veen tzarich lomar im mashach et hakkatze hashsheni keneged haaretz ad shehigbiah hattuma o sheggarar hattuma al haaretz. shezze nose vadday. veze vechol kayyotze bah hi tumat hesset haamura bechol makom: 
Hannose betoch bet hassetarim nitma sheaf al pi sheen hannegia sham negia hannose sham nose hu. ella im ken nivla hattuma betoch meav shemmeachar shehiggia letoch bitno eno lo nogea velo nose. veim taval tahor veaf al pi shehattuma betoch meav: 
En mittamme bemassa ella haadam bilvad lo hakkelim. ketzad. hare shehaya munnach al yado asara kelim ze al gabbe ze vehannevela vechayyotze bah bakkeli haelyon haadam tame mishshum nose nevela vehakkelim sheal yado kullan tehorim chutz mikkeli haelyon shennaga bo hattuma. vechen kayyotze baze: 
Tumat ohel enah bishar tumot ella bemet bilvad. uven sheheehil haadam o hakkeli afillu machat sheheehila al hammet o sheheehil hammet al haadam o al hakkelim o shehaya hammet im haadam o im hakkelim tachat ohel echad hare ellu temeim: 
Vetumat ohel haamura bechol makom hu shettetamme otah tuma haadam o hakkelim beachat mishshalosh derachim ellu. echad habba kullo leohel hammet o habba miktzato hare ze nitma beohel afillu hichnis yado o rashe etzbeotav o chatmo leohel hammet hare ze nitma kullo. naga bammashkof vetzeref yado im hammashkof nitma keillu ba miktzato. naga baaskuppa mittefach ulematta karov laaretz tahor. umittefach ulemala tame. veyerae li sheddavar ze middivrehem: 
Echad hammet miyyisrael o min haakkum metamme bemagga uvemassa: 
Veen haakkum metamme beohel vedavar ze kabbala hu vahare hu omer bemilchemet midyan <small>(Bamidbar lo 19)</small> "kl nogea bechalal" velo hazekir sham ohel. vechen haakkum eno naase teme met ella akkum shennaga bemet o nesao o heehil alav hare hu kemi shello naga. ha lema ze dome livhema shennaga bemet o heehila al hammet. velo betumat hammet bilvad ella bechol hattumot kullan en haakkum velo habbehema mittammein bahen: 
Umiddivre sofrim sheyyehu haakkum kezavin lechol divrehen. veen lecha bechol mine nefesh ma shemmittamme vehu chay o metamme vehu chay chutz min haadam bilvad. vehu sheyyihye miyyisrael. echad gadol veechad katan mittammein bechol hattumot afillu betumat hammet. shenneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 19 20)</small> "ish asher yitma" echad haish veechad hakkatan shehare hu omer sham <small>(Bamidbar 19 18)</small> "veal kol hannefashot asher hayu sham". afillu katan ben yomo shennaga o nasa o heehil al hammet nitma vahare hu teme met. vehu shennolad letisha. aval ben shemona hare hu keeven veeno mekabbel tuma: 
Hammet eno metamme ad shettetze nafsho afillu meguyyad o goses. afillu nishchatu bo shene hassimanim eno metamme ad shettetze nafsho shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 13)</small> "benefesh haadam asher yamut". nishbera mifrakto verov besarah immah o shennikra kedag miggabbo o shehuttaz rosho o shennechlak lishne chalakim bevitno hare ze metamme af al pi sheadayin hu merafref beechad meevarav:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by a Corpse 2:
Hannefel af al pi sheadayin lo nitkashsheru evarav begidin metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel keadam gadol shemmet shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 11)</small> "hannogea bemet lechol nefesh adam". vechen kezayit mibbesar hammet ben lach ben yavesh kecheres metamme kemet shalem. vehannetzel babbasar metamme bichzayit. ezehu netzel ze habbasar shennimmoach venaase lecha serucha. vehu shettikrosh otah hallecha hannimtzet min hammet sheim karsha beyadua shehu mibbesaro veim lo karsha enah metammea shemma kicho venio hu: 
Af al pi shehashshiurin kullam halacha lemoshe missinay hen amru chachamim techillat beriyyato shel adam kezayit ulefichach shiur tumat besaro kezayit: 
Evar shennechtach min haadam hachay hare hu kemet shalem metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel afillu evar katan shel katan ben yomo shehaevarim en lahem shiur shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 16)</small> "kl asher yigga al pene hassade bachalal cherev" vehaddavar yadua sheddin chalal cherev kedin chalal even o chalal shear devarim mippi hashshemua lamdu shello ba ze ella letamme nogea beevar sheppelatattu hacherev. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya haevar shalem kivriyyato basar vegidim vaatzamot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 16)</small> "o veetzem adam" etzem shehu keadam ma adam basar vegidim vaatzamot af evar min hachay ad sheyyihye kivriyyato basar vegidim vaatzamot. aval hakkulya vehallashon vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen evar bifne atzman hoil veen bahen etzem hare hen kishar habbasar. chasar min haetzem shel evar kol shehu hare haevar kullo tahor. chasar mibbesaro im nishar alav basar sherauy laalot bo arucha bechay veyitrappe veyishshalem. hare ze metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel. veim lav metamme bemagga uvemassa veeno metamme beohel. uvasar happoresh min hachay tahor. vechen etzem belo basar happoresh min hachay tahor: 
Evar happoresh min hammet metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel kemet vehu sheyyihye shalem kivriyyato basar vegidim vaatzamot. chasar atzmo im nishar alav basar kezayit metamme kemet shalem. chasar habbasar velo chasar haetzem im nishar alav kede laalot arucha bechay metamme kemet shalem veim lav hare hu kishar atzmot hammetim sheen alehen habbasar: 
Moach shebbetoch haetzem hare hu maale arucha mibbachutz. lefichach kulit hammet vehu etzem hassatum mishshene ketzotav im yesh betochah moach kede laalot arucha hare ze kemet shalem. haya bah moach hammitnadned im yesh bo kezayit hare ze metamme beohel af al pi shehaetzem satum mikkol tzedadav tuma bokaat veola bokaat veyoredet kemo sheyyitbaer shehammoach kevasar lechol davar: 
Haevar vehabbasar hameduldalim baadam af al pi sheen yecholin lachzor velichyot tehorim. met haadam hare habbasar tahor vehaevar metamme mishshum evar min hachay veeno metamme mishshum evar min hammet. ma ben evar min hachay leevar min hammet. evar min hachay basar happoresh mimmennu veetzem happoresh mimmennu tehorim veevar min hammet basar happoresh mimmennu veetzem happoresh mimmennu kimforashim min hammet hashshalem umetammein beshiuran: 
Uven evar min hachay ben evar min hammet en lahen shiur. amru chachamim matayim shemona vearbaim evarim yesh baish kol echad veechad mehen basar vegidim veetzem veen hashshinnayim min hamminyan. uveishsha matayim veechad vachamishshim. kol evar mehen shepperesh kivriyyato ben min hachay ben min hammet metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel chutz mishshelosha evarim yeterot shebbaishsha sheenan metammein beohel. vechen etzba yetera sheyyesh bah etzem veen bah tzipporen im nisperet al gav hayyad ola leminyan rov haevarim veim enah nisperet al gav hayyad metammea bemagga uvemassa veenah metammea beohel vetumatah middivre sofrim. veim haya bah tzipporen hare hi kishar haevarim. umippene ma gazru tuma al etzba sheenah nisperet gezera mishshum hannisperet. velamma lo timmeuha beohel asu lah hekker kede lehodia shettumatah middivrehem mishshum gezera kede shello yisrefu al tumatah teruma vekadashim: 
Atzmot hammet sheen alehem basar im nikkeret bahen tzurat atzamot hare ellu metammein bemagga uvemassa uveohel kemet shalem sheani kore bahem <small>(Bamidbar 19 16)</small> "etzem adam". veellu hen haatzamot shehen metammein kemet. hashshidra vehaggulgolet verov binyano verov minyano. hashshidra ketzad. shidra shehi shelema hare hi kemet shalem veim chasra afillu chulya achat mishshemone esre chulyot hare hi kishar haatzamot. haggulgolet ketzad. gulgolet shehi shelema hare hi kemet veim chasra kesela hare hi kishar haatzamot. hayu bah nekavim ketannim kullam mitztarfin lichsela. kol binyano shel adam hu shete hashshokayim vehayerechayim vehatztzelaot vehashshidra. verov binyano shel met hare hu kemet shalem. ketzad. kegon shete shokav veyarech achat im chaser rov binyano kol shehu hare hen kishar haatzamot. rov minyano ketzad. rov minyan atzamot kegon shehayu 125 etzem hare ellu kemet shalem. hayu 124 hare hen kishar haatzamot. af al pi shehaya adam ze yater beevarav o chaser beevarav en mashgichin bo ella al minyan rov kol adam ella im ken hayta etzba sheyyesh bah tzipporen o shehayta nisperet al gav hayyad shehi ola leminyan kemo shebbearnu: 
Shear atzmot hammet sheen bahen rov minyan velo rov binyan velo shidra shelema velo gulgolet shelema im haya bahen rova hakkav hare ellu metammeim kemet bemagga uvemassa uveohel. hayu pachot merova afillu etzem kisora metamme bemagga uvemassa veeno metamme beohel: 
Haya etzem echad afillu yesh bo rova hare ze metamme bemagga uvemassa veeno metamme beohel. tumat etzem echad halacha mippi hashshemua lefi shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 18)</small> "kol hannogea baetzem" lamdu mippi hashshemua afillu etzem kisora metamme bemagga uvemassa. ulefi shettumato halacha hare hu din tora velo middivre sofrim: 
Met shehirkivu atzmotav bakkever venaasu rekev. melo chafnayim meoto rekev metamme bemassa uveohel kemet veeno metamme bemagga lefi shei efshar ligga bechullo shehare eno guf echad. vaafillu gibbelo bemayim eno chibbur: 
Dam hammet metamme kemet bemagga uvemassa uveohel. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 13)</small> "benefesh haadam" veneemar <small>(Devarim 12 23)</small> "ki haddam hu hannafesh". vechamma shiuro reviit. afillu tamtzit haddam kol zeman sheyyesh bo admumit metamme beohel hammet: 
Dam hachay afillu dam nechira hare ze tahor kol zeman shehu chay. nitarev haddam sheyyatza mimmennu baacharona samuch lammita im haddam sheyyatza mimmennu achar shemmet vechol hattaarovot reviit veen yadua kamma yatza mechayyim vechamma yatza achar mita. afillu chatzi reviit mechayyim vechetzyah achar mita hare ze nikra dam tevusa umetamme bemassa uvemagga uveohel. ella shettumato middivre sofrim: 
Harug shehaya muttal al hammitta vedamo menattef keshehu chay veyored legumma umet vahare haddam menattef achar moto veyored leotah gumma. hare kol haddam shebbah tahor shettippa tippa rishona rishona batla kedam sheyyatza mechayyim. yatza mimmennu reviit dam bilvad vesafek kullah mechayyim safek kullah leachar mita hare zo sefek temea kishar hassefekot vehannogea bah birshut hayyachid tame birshut harabbim tahor kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Hakkever kol zeman shehattuma betocho metamme bemagga uveohel kemet din tora. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 16)</small> "o vemet o veetzem adam o vekaver". veechad hannogea begaggo shel kever o hannogea bichtalav. vehu sheyyihye banuy vesatum veachar kach yihye kullo metamme bemagga uveohel. aval hammaamid kelim o avanim vechayyotze bahen betzidde hammet vechissa alav millemala bechelim o baavanim vechayyotze bahen ze hakkissuy hammuttal millemala nikra golel veellu hatztzedadin hammaamidin et haggolel shehu nishan alehen nikrain dofek. ushenehem haggolel o haddofek metammein bemagga uveohel kekever vetumatan middivre sofrim veenan metammein bemassa. lefichach im garar haggolel bachavalim ad shekkissa bo et hammet. o geraro o shemato meal hammet. o sheggarar haddofek ad sheheemid alav haggolel o shemato bachavalim mittachat haggolel hare ze tahor. udevarim shessomchin et haddofek vehem hannikrain dofek dofkin hare hen tehorin: 
Sade shennechrash bah kever veavdu atzmot hammet baafarah hi hannikret bet happeras. vaafarah metamme bemagga uvemassa shemma yesh bah etzem kisora. veenah metammea beohel. vechen kol artzot haakkum afaran metamme bemagga uvemassa mippene haatzamot sheen nizharin bahen. vetumat bet happeras veeretz haakkum middivre sofrim kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by a Corpse 3:
Elu metammein bemagga uvemassa uveohel. hammet afillu nefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin. uchezayit mibbesar hammet. uchezayit netzel. veevar min hachay. veevar min hammet sheyyesh alehem basar karauy. vehashshidra vehaggulgolet. verov binyano verov minyano. verova atzamot mikkol makom af al pi sheen bahen lo rov binyan velo rov minyan. ureviit dam. ureviit dam tevusa. hakkol shetem esre: 
Veellu metammein bemagga uvemassa veen metammein beohel. evar min hachay shechasar besaro veen bo lehaalot arucha. veevar min hammet shechasar besaro o atzmo velo nishar basar kede lehaalot arucha o shechasar haetzem af al pi sheyyesh alav basar kede lehaalot arucha. vehashshidra shechasra veen bah rova atzamot. vehaggulgolet shechasra veen bah rova atzamot. veetzem afillu kisora. veeretz haakkum. uvet happeras. hakkol sheva: 
Haggolel vehaddofek metammein bemagga uveohel kekever veenan metammein bemassa. harekev metamme bemassa uveohel veeno metamme bemagga. tumat rova atzamot beohel vetumat reviit dam vetumat evar sheen alav basar karauy ben min hammet ben min hachay yerae li shekkullan tumatan enan din tora shehare en hannazir megalleach alehen kemo shebbearnu binzirut veen chayyavin alehen al biat hammikdash. veal tame betuma shel tora chayyav al biat hammikdash. lefichach ani omer shekkol tuma min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha enah din tora: 
En rekev hammet metamme ad sheyyikkaver arom bearon shel shayish o shel zechuchit vechayyotze bahen veyihye kullo shalem. chaser mimmennu evar o shennikbar bichsuto o bearon shel etz o shel mattechet en rikbo tame mippene sherekev hakkesut o rekev haetz o chaludat hammattechet titarev berekev geviyyato. verekev hametamme shennitarev bo afar kol shehu hare hu betumato. velo amru rekev ella lemet bilvad aval harug en lo rekev: 
Kavru shene metim keechad o sheggazzu searo o tzipparnav ukevarum immo o shekkavru ishsha meubberet veubbarah bemeeha en lahem rekev: 
Tachan hammet ad shennaasa rekev eno metamme ad sheyyarkiv meelav: 
Techano kullo vehinnicho ad sheyyarkiv o shehirkiv miktzato keshehu chay umet vehirkiv kullo hare ze safek. veim nitma limlo chafnayim merekev ze hare ze tame besafek: 
Melo chafnayim veod meafar hannimtza tachat hammet o meafar hannimtza bekever veen yadua ma tivo im hu rekev shemmetamme beohel o eno ella afar shennitlachlech benetzel hammet vedamo. hare ze metamme bemassa uveohel shehare yesh bimlo chafnayim veod melo chafnayim rekev. veyerae li sheaf zo tuma middivre sofrim: 
Hammet shennisraf veshildo kayyemet vehu hashshidra vehatztzelaot hare ze metamme kemet shalem veen tzarich lomar im nechrach. aval im nisraf ad shennitbalbela tzurat tavnito tahor. vechen shappir merukkam shetterafo bemayim tahor shehare nitbalbela tzurato: 
Besar hammet shennifrach venaasa kekemach tahor vechen efer hasserufin tahor vechen hattolaim hannehevin mibbesar hammet ben chayyim ben metim tehorin. uchevar bearnu shehammoach kevasar bechol makom ben bemet ben binvela vesheretz: 
Or haadam kivsaro veim ibbedo kol tzarko o hillech bo kede avoda hare ze tahor min hattora. aval middivrehem metamme bichzayit kivsar hammet gezera shello leharegil bene adam leabbed orot haadam veyishtammeshu bahen: 
Or habba keneged panav shel adam kesheyyivvaled ben shehaya chay veimmo chayya ben shennolad met veimmo meta hare ze tahor mippene shehu kemo peresh o tzoa veki vechayyotze bahen: 
Kol shebbammet tame chutz min hashshinnayim vehassear vehatztzipporen hoil vegizan machlif. uvishat chibburan hakkol tame. ketzad. hammet bachutz usearo betoch habbayit nitma kol asher babbayit. vechen hannogea bisaro o beshinnav o betzipparnav keshehen mechubbarin nitma. searo haomed lehiggazez vetzipparnav haomdim lehinnatel hoil vehen omdin lehinnatel yesh bahen safek lefichach hannogea bahen hare hu sefek tame. kol mashke hayyotze min hammetim tahor chutz middamo. vechol mare damim min hammet tame kemo shebbearnu. umippene ma lo gazru al mashke hammet kederech sheggazru al mashkin hayyotzin mikkol hattemein mippene shehammet hakkol bedelin mimmennu lo gazru al mashkav: 
Kaved shennimmocha metammea birviit mippene shehi kedam nikpa. dam katan sheyyatza kullo im en bo reviit tahor af al pi shehu kol dam shebbo: 
Veellu im chasru kol shehu tehorim. reviit dam. veetzem kisora. uchezayit basar. uchezayit netzel. umelo chafnayim rekev. veevar min hachay shechasar meatzmo kol shehu:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by a Corpse 4:
Reviit dam habbaa mishshene metim tehora ad shettihye kol harviit mimmet echad. shidra shennigmera mishshene metim kegon shehayu miktzat hachulyot meechad vetashluman mimmet acher vechen haggulgolet shel shene metim verova atzamot mishshene metim veevar min hammet mishshene metim kol ellu enan metammein beohel ella bemagga uvemassa kishar kol atzamot: 
Evar min hachay mishshene anashim tahor afillu meish echad im nechlak lishnayim tahor: 
Kezayit basar mishshene metim uchezayit netzel mishshene metim umelo chafnayim rekev mishshene metim shekkol echad mehen yesh lo rekev hare ellu mitztarfin ze im ze. vechen kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit netzel mitztarfin ze im ze. ushear kol hattumot shebbammet en mitztarfin ze im ze mippene shello shavu beshiurehen: 
Etzem kisora shennechlak lishnayim metamme bemassa. vechen rova atzmot met echad shenniddakdeku veen bechol echad mehem etzem kisora metammein beohel keillu lo niddakdeku: 
Kezayit min hammet shechatacho lachalakim veriddedo vedibbeko metamme beohel uvemassa veeno metamme bemagga ketzato af al pi shechibbero sheen chibbure adam chibbur: 
Kezayit chelev shalem shehitticho tame. haya meforad vehitticho tahor: 
Shidra shennigreru mimmenna rov chulyot shellah af al pi sheshshildah kayyemet enah metammea beohel. uvazzeman shehi betoch hakkever afillu meshubberet afillu mechuttetet metammea beohel mippene shehakkever metzarfah: 
Kol hametammein beohel shennechleku vehichnisan betoch habbayit haohel metzarfan umetammein beohel: 
Etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar bide shamayim vehichnis miktzato lefanim min habbayit nitma habbayit. shene atzamot vaalehem kishne chatzaye zetim basar vehichnis miktzatan lifnim habbayit tame. veim haya habbasar tachuv baatzamot bide adam habbayit tahor sheen chibbure adam chibbur: 
Melo chafnayim rekev shennitpazzer betoch habbayit habbayit tame: 
Reviit dam shennivlea betoch habbayit habbayit tahor lehabba vechol shehaya bo beet shennivlea harviit baaretz tame: 
Kezayit min hammet sheavad betoch habbayit uvikkesh velo nimtza, habbayit tahor. velichsheyyimmatze habbayit tame lemafrea meet sheavad ad shennimtza: 
Reviit dam shennishpach baavir im karash o shehaya bimkom ashboren vehu hammakom hannamuch kemo gumma veheehil hammaahil al miktzato nitma. nishpach al haaskuppa bammorad ben lefanim ben lachutz habbayit tahor. shehare lo nach haddam al haaskuppa. veim hayta haaskuppa ashboren o shekkarash haddam aleha habbayit tame. reviit dam shennivlea bichsut im mitkabbeset veyotza mimmennu reviit dam hare zo hakkesut mittammea bemagga uvemassa uveohel veim lav enah mittammea beohel vahare hi kichsut shennaga bemet shekkol habbalua sheeno yachol latzet tahor. ketzad meshaarin otah. mechabbesin otah bemayim umevi mayim kemiddatan venoten letochan reviit dam im haya marehen shave o shehaya me hakkibbus adom yoter mimme hammezeg beyadua sheyyatza mimmenna reviit: 
Hammassa vehammagga vehaohel shelosha shemot hem. vechol shehu mishshem echad mitztaref umetamme. umishshene shemot eno mitztaref vetahor. ketzad. hannogea bechishne chatzae zetim o shennasa shene chatzae zetim bevat achat. o sheheehil al kishne chatzae zetim. o sheheehil al chatzi zayit vachatzi zayit acher maahil alav. o shehaya hu vachatzi zayit tachat haohel veheehil bemiktzat gufo al chatzi zayit acher. o heehil chatzi zayit al miktzato. hakkol temeim mippene shehu shem echad. aval hannogea bachatzi zayit o hannose chatzi zayit vedavar acher maahil alav veal kachatzi zayit. o sheheehil alav chatzi zayit acher. o sheheehil hu al chatzi zayit acher. vechen hannose kachatzi zayit venaga bachatzi zayit acher. hakkol tehorim. sheen hammagga mitztaref im hammassa lo bemet velo bishar tumot. velo hammagga mitztaref im haohel velo haohel mitztaref im hammassa [lefi sheeno shem echad]:
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by a Corpse 5:
Kol hammittammein mechamat hammet ben adam ben kelim temeim tumat shiva. ketzad. adam o keli shennaga bidvarim shemmetammein min hammet bemagga. o shennitma beohel beechad middevarim shemmetammein beohel. vechen adam shennasa devarim shemmetammein min hammet bemassa. hakkol temeim tumat shiva shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 14)</small> "kol habba el haohel vechol asher baohel yitma shivat yamim": 
Adam shennitma bemet vechelim sheyyigga bahen adam ze temein tumat shiva shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar lo 24)</small> "vechibbastem bigdechem bayyom hashshevii utehartem". aval adam shennaga beadam shennitma bemet. ben shennaga bo achar shepperash mimmetammeav ben shennaga bo keshehu adayin nogea bemet. hare ze hashsheni tame tumat erev shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 22)</small> "vehannefesh hannogaat titma ad haarev". zehu din tora aval middivre sofrim hannogea bemet venaga beadam acher vaadayin hu mechubbar bammet shenehen temein tumat shiva ucheillu naga ze hashsheni bammet atzmo. bamme devarim amurim leinyan teruma vekadashim. aval lenazir uleose pesach ben bishat chibbur ben achar shepperash eno tame ella tumat erev kedin tora:

Tinok shettaval lemalleot ulehazzot lo yemalle bechelav tinok acher af al pi shettaval. vetinok shettaval lehazzot al kohen ze eno mazze al kohen acher ad sheyyitbol leshem maase ze hakkohen. vechen kelim shettiharum lechattat zo uvene adam shettiharum lechattat zo lo yitassek bahem befara acheret ad sheyyitbelu lishmah. vechol haddevarim haellu maalot yeterot befara:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 3:
En sorfin et happara ella chutz lehar habbayit shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "vehotzi otah" el michutz lammachane. uvehar hammishcha hayu sorfin otah. vechevesh hayu osin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha vetachtav banuy kippin kippin vechippa al kol shene kippin kede sheyyihyu shene ragle hakkippa al gag shene kippin shettachteha. kede shettihye tachat hakkol chalul mippene kever hattehom. af mekom serefatah umekom hattevila shehayu behar hammishcha tachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom. vehappara vehassoref vechol hamesaadin bisrefatah yotzin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha al gabbe kevesh ze: 
Ketzad sorfin otah. zikne yisrael hayu makdimin beraglehen lehar hammishcha uvet tevila haya sham. vechohen vehamesaadin bisrefatah vehappara yotzin al hakkevesh uvain lehar hammishcha. umetammein et hakkohen vesomchin hazzekenim et yedehem al hakkohen veomrim lo tevol achat. veim haya kohen gadol omrim lo ishi kohen gadol tevol achat. yarad vetaval veala venistappeg. veetzim mesuddarim hayu sham arazim allonim uveroshim vaatze teena chalaka. veosin maaracha kemin migdal umefattechin bah challonot kede shettihye haur melabbevet bahen. umare hammaaracha bemaarav. vechoftin et happara bechevel shel megeg venotnin otah al gabbe hammaaracha roshah ledarom ufaneha lemaarav. hakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. shochet bimino umekabbel haddam bismolo. umazze beetzbao hayemanit min haddam shebbechappo hassemalit sheva peamim keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim. al kol hazzaa tevilat etzba bedam. usheyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulim lehazzaya lefichach al kol hazzaa mekanneach etzbao begufah shel para. gamar millehazzot mekanneach et yadav begufah shel para veyored min hammaaracha vehitztzit et haesh beetzim ketannim vehichnisan tachat atze hammaaracha vehitchil haesh bah vehakkohen omed berachok umeshammer lah ad sheyyitztzat et haur berubbah vetikkara bitnah. veachar kach notel etz erez veezov en pachot mittefach vetzemer tzavua betolaat mishkal chamishsha selaim veomer laomdim sham. etz erez ze etz erez ze etz erez ze. ezov ze ezov ze ezov ze. sheni tolaat ze sheni tolaat ze sheni tolaat ze. shalosh peamim al kol echad veechad. vehen omrin lo hen hen hen shalosh peamim al kol echad veechad. vechol kach lamma lefi shemmine arazim shiva hen umine ezov arbaa vehatztzavua adom yesh shetztzovin oto befua veyesh shetztzovin oto belakka veyesh shetztzovin oto betolaat vehattolaat hi haggargerim haadummim beyoter haddomim legarine hecharuvim vehen kemo haog vetolaat kemo yattush yesh bechol gargir mehen ulefichach modia lakkol umegalle lahen sheellu hen hamminim haamurim battora. vehaezov haamur battora hu haezov sheochlin oto baale battim umetabbelin bo hakkederot. haezov vehaerez vehattolaat shelashtan meakkevin ze et ze. vechorech haezov im haerez belashon shel shani umashlich el toch bitnah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 6)</small> "vehishlich el toch serefat happara". veeno mashlich kodem sheyyatztzit haur berubbah velo achar shettease efer veim hishlich pesula shenneemar el toch serefat lo kodem sheyyitztzat haur berubbah velo achar shettease efer. ben shehishlich shelashtan keachat ben shehishlich ze achar ze ben shehishlich letoch gufah o letoch serefatah ben shennikrea meeleha veachar kach hishlich ben shekkeraah beyado o bichli keshera: 
Nigmera serefatah chovtin otah bemaklot hi vechol atze hammaaracha shennisrefa bahen vechovrin et hakkol bichvarot vechol shachor sheefshar sheyyikkatesh veyihye efer ben mibbesarah ben min haetzim kotshin oto ad sheyyease efer vesheen bo efer mannichin oto vechol etzem shennishar meatzameha belo serefa ben kach uven kach haya nichtash: 
En machnisin kelum meefrah lehannicho baazara shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "vehinniach michutz lammachane". ushelosha chalakim hayu cholkin et kol efrah echad nittan bachel veechad behar hammishcha veechad mitchallek lechol hammishmarot. ze shemmitchallek lechol hammishmarot hayu hakkohanim mekaddeshin mimmennu. veze shennittan behar hammishcha hayu yisrael mazzin mimmennu. veze shennittan bachel haya muchan umutzna shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret" melammed shemmatzniin mimmennu. vechen hayu matzniin meefer kol para ufara shessorfin bachel. vetesha parot adummot naasu mishshennitztauu bemitzva zo ad shecharav habbayit bashsheniyya. rishona asa moshe rabbenu. sheniyya asa ezra. vesheva meezra ad churban habbayit. vehaasirit yaase hammelech hammashiach mehera yiggale amen ken yehi ratzon:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 4:
En shochatin shete parot adummot keachat shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "veshachat otah": 
Lo ratzta para latzet en motziin immah shechora shello yomru shechora shachatu velo adumma shello yomru shetayim shachatu: 
Para shennishchata shello lishmah o shekkibbel o shehizza shello lishmah o lishmah veshello lishmah o shello lishmah velishmah o shennaaset shello bechohen o bimchussar begadim o sheasaah bevigde zahav o bevigde chol pesula. shechatah al menat leechol mibbesarah o lishtot middamah keshera lefi shello neemar bah reach nichoach: 
Kibbel damah bichli pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 4)</small> "velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao" mitzvatah mitzvat yad velo mitzvat keli: 
Hizza bichli afillu achat mehen hazzaato pesula. hizza achat mehen bismolo pesula. hizzu shiva kohanim hazzayatan keechad hazzayatan pesula. ze achar ze keshera. hizza velo kivven keneged hahechol pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 4)</small> "el nochach pene ohel moed" ad sheyyechavven keneged hahechol veyihye roehu. vechen im shechatah o serafah shello keneged hahechol pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "veshachat otah lefanav": 
Bamme devarim amurim shehizza o saraf o shachat keneged haddarom o keneged tzafon o shehaya achorav lammikdash. aval im amad ben mizrach umaarav ufanav keneged hahechol af al pi shello kivven keneged [hahechol] bedikduk keshera: 
Chisser achat min hammattanot pesula. taval shetayim vehizza achat hazzaato pesula. taval achat vehizza shetayim af al pi shello chashav hazzaa sheniyya ella taval vehizza acheret hazzayato pesula. ketzad. taval etzbao tevila shishshit vehizza shesh vesheva af al pi shechazar vetaval etzbao vehizza sheva hazzayato pesula. hizza mittevila sheviit [sheviit] usheminit afillu chazar vetaval tevila sheminit vehizza sheminit keshera shekkol shemmosif al hashsheva eno kelum. vehu sheyyihye ze shehosif kohen acher aval hakkohen hassoref otah im hosif pesula mippene shennitassek bedavar sheeno tzarich bishat serefatah: 
Hotzi et haddam chutz mimmaarachtah vehizza pesula: 
Hizza middamah ballayla afillu hizza shesh hazzayot bayyom veachat ballayla pesula: 
Shechatah chutz mimmekom serefatah afillu shechatah lefanim min hachoma pesula: 
Serafah chutz mimmaaracha shennishchata aleha. o shechillekah lishnayim userafah bishte maarachot. o shessaraf shetayim bemaaracha achat pesula. veim achar shennaaset efer mevi acheret soref al gabbah veeno choshesh: 
Hifshitah unetachah veachar kach saraf kullah keshera. veim chisser mimmenna kelum afillu mippirshah pesula. paka meorah o mibbesarah afillu missearah kezayit yachzir veim lo hechzir pesula. paka chutz lemaarachtah marbe alav vesorfo bimkomo. paka mikkarneha mittelafeha o mippirshah eno tzarich lehachezir: 
Happara enah nifselet belina lefichach im nishchata hayyom vehizza damah kehilchato venisrefa lemachar keshera: 
Serafah onen o mechussar kappara keshera: 
Serafah shello bekiddush yadayim veraglayim pesula mippene shemmaaseha keen avoda. vehechan mekaddesh yadav veraglav bichli sharet bifnim veim kiddesh bachutz umikkeli chol afillu bimkeda shel cheres kasher hoil vechol maaseha bachutz. vechen keshemmatbilin et hakkohen hassoref achar shemmetammein oto kemo shebbearnu eno tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh hoil vechol maaseha bitvule yom: 
Serafah shello beetzim o bechol etzim afillu bekash o bigvava keshera. umitzvatah shello yemaet lah etzim min harauy lah aval marbe hu lah chavile ezov veezov yon bizman serefa kede leharebot et haefer. veyesh lo leharebot etzim bisrefatah ad shettease efer aval mishshettease efer im hosif bah afillu etz echad hare ze kimarev efer makle beefer happara: 
Kol maase happara mittechilla vead sof eno ella bayyom. uvezichre kehunna. vehammelacha poselet bah ad shettease efer. aval mishshettease efer im kanas efrah ballayla o shekkenasattu ishsha o sheasa melacha acheret bishat kenisato hare zo keshera. uminnayin sheasifat haefer bechol adam miyyisrael chutz mecheresh shote vekatan shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 9)</small> "veasaf ish tahor" mikkelal sheenah tzericha kohen ucheillu amar adam tahor ben ish ben ishsha. uminnayin shehammelacha poselet bah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 3)</small> "veshachat otah" mippi hashshemua lamdu shello ba hakkatuv ella lelammed sheim nitassek bedavar acher bishat shechitatah pesalah veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 5)</small> "vesaraf et happara leenav" sheyyihyu enav bah lelammed shehammelacha poselet bah mishsheat shechita ad shettease efer. vechol haosek bisrefatah veasa melacha acheret pesalah ad shettease efer: 
Shachat et happara venishchata behema acheret immah o nechtecha delaat immah keshera shehare lo nitkavven limlacha af al pi shehabbehema shennishchata immah keshera laachila sheen shechitat hachullin tzericha kavvana. aval im nitkavven lachtoch haddelaat venechtecha bishat shechita pesula shehare asa immah melacha:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 5: Kol haoskin bappara mittechilla vead sof metammein begadim kol zeman asiyyatan shenneemar beshochet umashlich etz erez <small>(Vayikra 15 13)</small> "vechibbes begadav verachatz besaro" veneemar besoref <small>(Bamidbar 19 8)</small> "vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 10)</small> "vechibbes haosef et efer happara" melammed shekkol haoskin bah mittechilla vead sof metammeim begadim uteunin tevila vehaarev shemesh din tora. aval hameshammerah bishat asiyyatah metamme begadim middivrehem gezera shemma yaziz bah evar:

Kol makom shenneemar battora betumot yechabbes begadav lo ba lelammedenu shehabbegadim shealav bilvad hem temeim. ella lelammed shekkol beged o keli sheyyigga bo hattame hazze bishat chibburo bimtammeav hare hen temeim. aval achar sheyyifrosh mimmetammeav eno metamme begadim. ketzad. hannose et hannevela echad beged shealav o keli sheyyigga bo kol zeman shehu nosah hare hen temein vahare hen rishon letuma. vechen ze hannose hare hu rishon. perash mimmetammeav vehishlich et hannevela hare hu rishon kemot shehaya. veim yigga bichli o beged eno metamme oto sheen velad tuma metamme kelim kemo shebbearnu bitchillat sefer ze. vechen kol kayyotze binvela. vechen kol haoskin bappara im naga beveged o bichli bishat shechita o bishat serefa hare hen temein. aval achar sheyyifrosh mimmaaseha af al pi sheadayin lo taval im naga bichli eno metammeo mippene shehu velad hattuma. vehappara atzmah enah metammea lo adam velo kelim shennagu bo. ella hammitassek bah bilvad hu hattame vetaun tevila umetamme begadim kol zeman sheosek bah:

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shennisrefet kemitzvatah. aval im nifsela hammitassek bah tahor. era pissul bishchitatah enah metammea begadim. era pissul behazzayatah kol haosek bah lifne pissulah metamme begadim. leachar pissulah eno metamme begadim:

Hishlim lichnos et efrah hammitassek bah achar ken bechilluk heafar o behatzenaato vechen hannogea bo tahor. velo happara bilvad ella kol hachattaot hannisrafot min happarim umin hasseirim hassorfam metamme begadim bishat serefato ad sheyyeasu efer. shehare hu omer befar vesair shel yom hakkippurim <small>(Vayikra 16 28)</small> "vehassoref otam yechabbes" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze binyan av lechol hannisrafim sheyyehu metammein begadim ad sheyyeasu efer. bamme devarim amurim beshello era lahen pissul venisrefu kemitzvatan bevet haddeshen. aval im nifselu baazara nisrafin sham kifsule hammukdashin vesorfan tahor. vechen hammitassek bahen mishsheyyeasu efer eno metamme begadim. vee zehu soref ze hammassia bisrefa kegon hamehappech babbasar vehammashlich etzim vehamehappech baesh vehachote gechalim kede shettivar haesh vechayyotze bahen. aval hammatztzit haur vehamesadder et hammaaracha tahor. kach lamdu mippi hashshemua shehannose parim useirim hannisrafin lehotzian levet haddeshen lesarfan tame umetamme begadim din tora kol zeman shehu osek beholachatan vetaun tevila vehaarev shemesh. kemo hameshalleach et hassair laazazel shehu metamme kol beged vechol keli sheyyigga bo bechelim shealav kol zeman shemmitassek bishlucho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 26)</small> "vehameshalleach et hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav":

Meematay metammein begadim hannosin parim useirim hannisrafim. mishsheyyetzu bahen chutz lechomat haazara. nesaum bemotot veyatzu miktzat hannosim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu. ellu sheyyatzu metammein begadim veellu sheadayin lo yatzu enan metammein begadim ad sheyyetzu. yatzu vechazru laazara hannose otan baazara tahor ad sheyyetze bahen. haya omed chutz laazara umoshech otam mishsham meachar shechazru hoil uchevar yatzu lachutz vahare ze hammoshcham bachutz hare hu sefek tame:
Umeematay metamme begadim hameshalleach et hassair. mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim ad sheat dechiyyato laazazel. aval achar sheddachahu im naga bechelim uvivgadim tehorim:

Hannogea befarim uvisirin hannisrafin atzman afillu achar sheyyatzu ben adam ben kelim ben ochalin ben mashkin hakkol tahor. vechen im nagu bassair hammishtalleach atzmo bizman holachato tehorin. sheen ellu metammein ella lammitassek bahen bilvad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 8)</small> "vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav" aval hannogea tahor:
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 6: Hammayim shennotnin alav efer happara en memallein otan ella bichli. umin hammayanot o min hanneharot hammoshchin. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 19 17)</small> "venatan alav mayim chayyim el keli". unetinat efer happara al hammayim shennitmalleu hu hannikra kiddush. vehammayim haellu shennittan alehen haefer hen hannikrain me chattat umayim mekuddashin vehem shekkeraan hakkatuv <small>(Bamidbar 19)</small> "me nidda":

Hakkol kesherim lemalleot hammayim chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. vehakkol kesherin lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. veen memallein veen mekaddeshin ella bichli veen mazzin ella mikkeli. vehammilluy vehakkiddush kesherin ballayla aval en mazzin veen tovlin ella bayyom. vechol hayyom kasher lehazzaa velitvila:

Bechol hakkelim memallein umazzin umekaddeshin afillu bichle gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama uvisfina. veechad kele cheres veechad kol hakkelim. aval en memallein veen mekaddeshin velo mazzin bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bimgufat hechavit velo bechafnav velo bevetzat hattarnegolet velo beshoket shebbassela. aval betzat hayyotzrim keshera mippene shehi keli adama:

Shule kele etz uchele zechuchit uchele etzem en mekaddeshin bahen ad sheyyashuf otan vitakkenem veyaasem kelim bifne atzman. vechen megufa shehitkinah lihyot keli mekaddeshin bah. uvetzat hannaamit keshera lekaddesh bah veen tzarich lomar shekkeshera lemalleot bah ulehazzot mimmenna:

Keli shechibbero baaretz o bassela afillu chibbero besid mekaddeshin bo umazzin mimmennu. asa atara shel tit saviv lakkeli vehammayim shebbakkeli tzafin ad shehalchu laatara im nittelet haatara im hakkeli hare hammayim shebbetochah kesherim shehare hen bichli adama veim lav hare hen kemi shehikkif atara shel tit bassela o al haaretz umille otah mayim shehen pesulin mippene sheenan bichli:
Keli cheres shennikkav bechones mashke en memallein umekaddeshin bo aval im nikkav bemotzi mashke mekaddeshin bo:
Keli shennikkav millematta usetamo bismartutin pasul shehammayim shebbo enan al iggul hakkeli ella al happekak. haya nakuv min hatztzad ufekako hare ze kasher lemalleot ulekaddesh ulehazzot mimmennu:

Hazzolef mayim min hammayan beyadav uveraglav uvacharasim venatan letoch hechavit pesulin mippene shello nitmalleu bichli. natan et hechavit bemayim vedachak hammayim beyadav o beraglav o baale yerakot kede sheyyaavru lechavit hare ellu pesulin. vechen im shikkeo bemayim kede sheyyigberu hammayim veyaalu veyishshafchu lechavit pesulin. veim asa ken baale kanim o baale egoz hare hammayim kesherim. ze hakkelal davar shehu mekabbel tuma im siyyea bo hammayim kede sheyyemalleu hakkeli hammayim pesulin veim siyyea bedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma kesherim:
Hamefanne hammayan letoch haggat o letoch haggeve vechazar umille bichli meoto haggeve o haggat pesulim shehare tzarich shettihye lekichat hammayim min hammayan bichli battechilla:
Hayyam haggadol kemikve veeno kemayan lefichach en memallein mimmennu lekiddush. vechol hanneharot pesulin lekaddesh mehen me chattat. ushear hayyammim kemayan:
Vehammayim hannigrarin mishshear hayyammim vehen hannikrain zochalin pesulin. vehazzochalin min hammayan hare hem kemayan uchesherim:

Mayim hammukkin vehamechazzevin pesulin. veellu hen hammukkin hammeluchim o happoshrim vehamechazzevim hem hammayanot sheppeamim mekerin ufeamim charevin viveshin afillu hayu charevin paam achat lesheva shanim pesulin. aval im hayu charevin bishne batztzoret o leshanim rabbot yeter mishsheva o shehayu memehen peamim merubbin ufeamim muatin veenan charevin hare ellu kesherim. umayan hayyotze battechilla kasher veeno tzarich livdok shemma yechazzev:

Me bitztzim ume hayyarden ume hayyarmuch pesulin mippene shehen me hattaarovot. veellu hen me hattaarovot. mayim kesherim lekiddush shennitarvu bemayim pesulin en memallein mittaarovet shenehem. aval mayim kesherim shennitarvu bemayim kesherim kegon meme shete hammayanot shennitarvu venimshechu memallein mehen:
Hammayim shennishtannu shinnuyan mechamat atzman kesherin:
Beer shennafal letochah charsit o adama venaasu memeha achurin memalle mimmenna veen tzarich lehametin. nafal letochah shetef shel meme geshamim yamtin ad shettitztzal:

Ammat hammayim habbaa merachok hoil utechillatah min hammayan keshera lemalleot mimmenna. uvilvad sheyyishmerenna shello yifsekenna adam venimtza memalle min hammayim sheppasku techillatan min hammayan shehen pesulin:
